name: Bedrock Tortoise
oracle_text:
During your turn, creatures you control have hexproof.
Each creature you control with toughness greater than its power assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power.
blocked_sentences: Each creature you control with toughness greater than its power assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power.

needs.what: a static-filter key matching a creature whose own toughness is greater than its own power (a per-object comparison of the two characteristics), usable in the `affects` of a `combat_damage_by_toughness` static: {"controller": "you", "types": ["Creature"], "toughness_greater_than_power": true}
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `combat_damage_by_toughness` static exists, but its `affects` filter can only compare `power`/`toughness` against a fixed integer (`compare_pt` takes {op, value} with a plain int); there is no static_affects_filter_key that compares an object's toughness to its own power. Dropping the clause would make every creature you control (e.g. a 5/2) assign damage by toughness, which is a different card.
